witness.branch: Speeding context plus repeated following conduct and causal hazard evidence
witness.quote: Following another vehicle too closely in violation of NRS 484B.127
witness.reason: The following task supports repeated following encounters, but the complete composite requires additional conduct and causal hazard context.
required_context: Construct another vehicle or person interaction and retain physical evidence bearing on the driver's creation of a hazard.
Do not substitute headway, time-to-conflict or speed thresholds for unresolved legal standards.
Identify the same driver in actual physical control throughout one continuous driving period and establish vehicle and highway scope.
Measure the traveled distance enclosing all conduct within the course of 1 mile; a full-mile trace is not required.
Place another vehicle or person in a physically supported interaction bearing on hazard creation.
Provide applicable speeding authority and circumstances under NRS 484B.363 or NRS 484B.600.
Provide two distinct following episodes and the operative NRS 484B.127 requirements and exceptions; do not count arbitrary samples as separate acts.
Record the event-enclosing traveled distance within the statutory course of 1 mile.
Same identified conventional-vehicle driver remains in actual physical control during one continuous driving period.
Specify lead and subject routes and two genuinely distinct following episodes rather than counting samples as acts.
Supply applicable NRS 484B.363 or NRS 484B.600 requirements and circumstances, and operative NRS 484B.127 requirements and exceptions; their full texts remain unresolved in the supplied materials.
The fixed other vehicle is explicitly the lead vehicle; establish both routes, positions and motion.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver can be the same driver performing all conduct groups.
